mapper.select:
SELECT ENTRUST_ID code FROM ETR_ENTRUST
ENTRUST_ID LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')

SELECT TYPE_6,TYPE_7, TYPE_9, TYPE_10, TYPE_11 /* 原因、zhuyongkang 2019/7/30 end*/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE
FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(YIELD*100,99990.9999)) FROM ( SELECT PA.YIELD FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FIN.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{rateType} AND PA.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY PA.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT CCY FROM ( SELECT FIN.CCY FROM PA_FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE PA LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FIN ON FIN.CASH_ID = PA.CASH_ID WHERE FIN.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} ORDER BY FIN.UPDATE_TIME DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT AD.PROD_REGIST_CODE FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD AD ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = AD.FINPROD_ID
FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{portfolioId} AND FIN.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2}

SELECT T.CLOSE_PRICE FROM ( SELECT M.CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE M
BASIS_CYY = #{basisCcy} AND TRADE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{tradeDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') AND QUOT_CYY = #{quotCcy} ORDER BY TRADE_DATE DESC
) T
ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DISTINCT R.EFF_DATE effDate, R.BASIS basis, R.YIELD yield, FCPR.CALC_RULE calcRule, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN P LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE R ON P.CASH_ID = R.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR on P.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID
AND P.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND R.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDate},'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY R.EFF_DATE
